privileged_info_for_vlm: The custom ViewTemplate must have the system tag '$:/tags/ViewTemplate'. It must use a filter to only show content for tiddlers tagged 'Paper'. The specific fields to be displayed are 'author', 'journal', 'year', and 'doi'. Existing tiddlers that should trigger this template include 'Attention Is All You Need', 'MapReduce', and 'ResNet'.
